# warpbuild_runner (Resource)

A custom BYOC runner set. Jobs request it by label; WarpBuild provisions EC2 instances into the referenced stack using the configured image and instance types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "warpbuild_stack" "ec2" {
  alias = "my-ec2-stack"
}

resource "warpbuild_runner" "custom" {
  name        = "my-custom-runner"
  provider_id = data.warpbuild_stack.ec2.id

  # Warm pool instances kept ready for jobs; ondemand runners only.
  pool_size = 1

  configuration = {
    image = warpbuild_runner_image.custom.id

    byoc_sku = {
      arch           = "x64"
      instance_types = ["m5.xlarge", "m5.2xlarge"]
      role_arn       = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/WarpBuildRunnerRole"
    }

    storage = {
      tier = "custom"
      size = 256
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) Hardware and image configuration for the runner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `name` (String) Name of the runner, unique within the organization. Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens.
- `pool_size` (Number) Number of warm pool instances. Warm pools apply to `ondemand` runners only.
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the stack the runner provisions instances into. Use the `warpbuild_stack` data source to look this up.

### Optional

- `labels` (Set of String) Labels used to select this runner in CI workflows. Defaults to the runner name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Runner ID.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `byoc_sku` (Attributes) EC2 instance selection for the BYOC runner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--byoc_sku))
- `image` (String) Runner image ID (e.g. from a `warpbuild_runner_image` resource) or a WarpBuild stock image alias like `ubuntu-2404`.

Optional:

- `capacity_type` (String) `ondemand` or `spot`.
- `storage` (Attributes) Instance storage configuration. Server defaults apply when omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--storage))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--byoc_sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.byoc_sku`

Required:

- `arch` (String) CPU architecture: `x64` or `arm64`.
- `instance_types` (List of String) Acceptable EC2 instance types, in order of preference.

Optional:

- `imdsv2_required` (Boolean) Enforce IMDSv2 (disable IMDSv1) on instances.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether instances get public IPs.
- `role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role ARN attached to runner instances.


<a id="nestedatt--configuration--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.storage`

Optional:

- `iops` (Number) Provisioned IOPS.
- `size` (Number) Disk size in GB.
- `throughput` (Number) Disk throughput in MB/s.
- `tier` (String) Storage tier: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `extreme` or `custom`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import warpbuild_runner.custom <runner-id>
```
